features.name: Landing Page
features.description: Public landing page with hero section, feature highlights, and CTA buttons
test_steps: Visit root URL /
Verify hero section displays BuildWise Cashflow branding
Verify 6 feature cards are visible
Click 'Get Started' navigates to /login
Test responsive layout on mobile viewport

features.name: Login Page
features.description: Authentication page with email/password form and remember me option
test_steps: Visit /login
Verify login form displays with email and password fields
Verify 'Remember me' checkbox exists
Submit form redirects to /dashboard
Test responsive layout on mobile viewport

features.name: Dashboard Layout
features.description: Main dashboard layout with sidebar navigation and header
test_steps: Visit /dashboard
Verify sidebar displays with all navigation items
Verify user avatar and name in sidebar footer
Verify logout button functions
Test sidebar collapse on mobile

features.name: Dashboard Overview
features.description: Main dashboard with financial summary cards, charts, and quick links
test_steps: Visit /dashboard
Verify 4 financial summary cards display (Cash, Bank, Receivables, Payables)
Verify cash flow trend chart renders with 7-day data
Verify 3 module quick link cards are clickable
Verify Recent WIP Alerts section shows 4 items
Verify Recent Transactions section shows 5 items
Verify Active Projects grid shows project cards
Test toast notification appears on page load

features.name: Projects List
features.description: Project listing page with search, filters, and project cards
test_steps: Visit /dashboard/projects
Verify project count summary displays
Verify search input filters projects by name
Verify status tabs filter projects (All, Active, On-Hold, Completed)
Verify project cards show budget utilization
Click project card navigates to detail page

features.name: Project Detail
features.description: Individual project view with stats, charts, transactions, and documents
test_steps: Visit /dashboard/projects/[id]
Verify project header with name and status badge
Verify statistics cards (Budget, Spent, Progress, Duration)
Verify budget breakdown chart renders
Verify recent transactions list
Verify project documents section
Back button returns to projects list

features.name: Live Tally Feed
features.description: Real-time transaction feed with filters and export functionality
test_steps: Visit /dashboard/tally
Verify transaction summary cards (Receipts, Payments, Net)
Verify transaction list displays with type indicators
Verify filter tabs (All, Receipts, Payments) work
Verify search filters by party name
Verify Export to CSV button downloads file
Verify transaction status badges display correctly

features.name: WIP Analysis
features.description: Work-in-progress issue tracking with severity levels and filters
test_steps: Visit /dashboard/wip
Verify summary cards (Total Issues, Critical, New)
Verify issue type tabs filter correctly
Verify search filters by title/project
Verify severity badges (critical=red, warning=yellow, info=blue)
Verify issue cards show budgeted vs actual amounts
Verify status badges (new, viewed, reviewed)

features.name: Reports Module
features.description: Report listing with category filters, search, and export
test_steps: Visit /dashboard/reports
Verify category statistics chart renders
Verify category filter tabs work
Verify search filters by report name
Verify Export All CSV button works
Verify file type icons display correctly (PDF, XLSX)
Verify download buttons on report cards

features.name: Documents Module
features.description: Document management with type filters and upload UI
test_steps: Visit /dashboard/documents
Verify document type filter tabs
Verify search filters documents
Verify upload button displays dialog
Verify document cards show metadata (size, date, project)

features.name: Schedules Module
features.description: Gantt-style project schedule with hierarchical tasks
test_steps: Visit /dashboard/schedules
Verify project selector dropdown
Verify task tree displays hierarchically
Verify expand/collapse toggles work
Verify progress bars show correct percentages
Verify status badges (Completed, In Progress, Not Started, Delayed)

features.name: Settings Module
features.description: User settings with profile, notifications, and display preferences
test_steps: Visit /dashboard/settings
Verify profile section shows user info
Verify notification toggle switches work
Verify display settings (dark mode, compact view) work
Verify data management section displays

features.name: Mobile Responsiveness
features.description: All pages optimized for mobile viewports with collapsible sidebar
test_steps: Test all pages at 375px viewport width
Verify sidebar collapses to hamburger menu
Verify grids stack to single column
Verify text truncation on small screens
Verify touch targets are minimum 44px

features.name: Loading States
features.description: Skeleton loading states for all dashboard pages
test_steps: Navigate to /dashboard with network throttling
Verify skeleton loaders display during load
Verify projects page has loading skeleton
Verify WIP page has loading skeleton

features.name: Dark Mode Support
features.description: Theme toggle for light/dark mode with system preference detection
test_steps: Visit /dashboard/settings
Toggle dark mode switch
Verify all pages render correctly in dark mode
Verify charts adapt to dark theme

features.name: CSV Export
features.description: Export functionality for transactions and reports
test_steps: Visit /dashboard/tally
Click Export to CSV button
Verify CSV file downloads with correct data
Visit /dashboard/reports
Click Export All button
Verify reports CSV downloads

features.name: Toast Notifications
features.description: User feedback via toast notifications using Sonner
test_steps: Visit /dashboard
Verify success toast appears
Export CSV and verify success toast
Verify toast auto-dismisses after delay

features.name: INR Currency Formatting
features.description: Proper Indian Rupee formatting with lakhs/crores
test_steps: Verify amounts display with Indian number formatting
Verify compact format shows L (lakhs) and Cr (crores)
Verify INR symbol displays correctly
